description: This source file implements the API for retrieving device processor information, including processor count and architecture, using system calls and managing instances via hash tables and mutexes.

classes.name: hostIf_DeviceProcessorInterface
classes.description: Class managing device processor information, including instance management, processor count, and architecture retrieval.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns an instance of hostIf_DeviceProcessorInterface for a given device ID, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getAllInstances
methods.description: Returns a list of all existing hostIf_DeviceProcessorInterface instances.

methods.name: closeInstance
methods.description: Removes and deletes a specific hostIf_DeviceProcessorInterface instance.

methods.name: closeAllInstances
methods.description: Removes and deletes all hostIf_DeviceProcessorInterface instances.

methods.name: getNumOfProcessorEntries
methods.description: Counts the number of processors by reading /proc/cpuinfo.

methods.name: get_Device_DeviceInfo_Processor_Architecture
methods.description: Retrieves the processor architecture (machine type) using uname and updates the message data.
